ceiling.note: Phase 11 called sqrt(R(22)) the coverage-aware ceiling. Phase 15 shows that R(22) is identified for only 39 of 126 targets; 0.560 is therefore an extrapolated point estimate, not a bound. Use R_obs or R_id with their jackknife intervals and the audit label.

decision.label: not_calibrated
decision.note: A calibrated descriptive interval is not a causal, transport, ranking or animal-budget claim.

description: Measurement-bounded evaluation of C. elegans neural-response predictions. Reliability is reported as three separate estimands; R_22 is a counterfactual extrapolation, not an identified bound.
limitations: R_22 is extrapolated for 87 of 126 targets and the half-split extrapolation gate failed.
Delete-one-animal intervals are reported only with the calibration status in the audit.
Null controls were run; read their medians and q95 values, not only the point estimate.
Target rankings did not replicate and are not published.
No causal, transport, digital-twin, foundation-model, or animal-budget claim is supported.
The derived Randi trial table is not redistributed until its licence is confirmed.
